en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a grand villa or small castle with multiple turrets and a tall, slender tower in a landscaped setting. In the foreground, a group of women and children in late‑19th‑ or early‑20th‑century clothing stand and sit in a grassy field. Additional smaller wooden buildings and outdoor seating are visible to the right, with hills or a river valley in the distant background. Decorative red text is printed at the top and along the right margin.
